## Added
- Listen on the go with Tailscale: the Proxmox and Debian installers set it up on request, no port forwarding needed
- Android and desktop apps switch to the Tailscale address by themselves when the server at home is not reachable
- Settings show the address for on the go, plus a step by step guide (`docs/tailscale.md`)
- New phone layout: greeting with quick tiles, rows that scroll sideways, colourful browse tiles in search, library as a list, album pages with a big cover, colour from the cover and a round play button

## Fixed
- Nothing

## Install
- **Update server and set up Tailscale (Proxmox node shell):** run the installer again and answer `y` to the Tailscale question: `bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Labtoso/Musik/main/deploy/proxmox.sh)"`
- **Update server (Debian / Ubuntu):** `musik-update --tailscale`
- **Android:** install the new `Musik.apk` over the old one
- **Windows:** run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
- **Phone on the go:** install the Tailscale app and log in with the same account, see `docs/tailscale.md`
